limitations: Native Windows/WebView2 execution is not available on this Linux build host.
The full 550-million-point user project is unavailable; the largest new permanent-removal fixture has 550,003 points.
No new full-cloud cleaning accuracy, segmentation performance or universal deletion speed claim.
Permanent removal clears the entire workspace Undo/Redo history; original imports and other saved references remain protected.
Amberg screenshots inform organisation; Amberg file compatibility or construction-stage feature parity is not claimed.
